title: Positive real linear monad normal forms

items.title: Positive real linear monad normal forms
items.statement: Assume AC. On CP3 with coordinates (λ1,λ2,μ1,μ2) and σ=(-barλ2,barλ1,-barμ2,barμ1), let O(-1)⊗U→O⊗K→O(1)⊗U′ be a linear bundle monad with dimensions k,2k+N,k, N≥2, locally free middle cohomology F, trivial on every real line μ1=z1λ1−barz2λ2,μ2=z2λ1+barz1λ2, and unitary framing on λ=0. Give F a nondegenerate holomorphic σ-Hermitian pairing whose induced forms on real-line sections are positive. Then there are normalized internal Hermitian spaces and chain identifications giving α=(A,C,Jλ1+I†λ2)T, β=(-C,A,Iλ1−J†λ2), A=B1λ1−B2†λ2−μ1, C=B2λ1+B1†λ2−μ2, with raw zero moments and stable-and-costable regularity. Normalized framed real monad isomorphisms correspond exactly to simultaneous U(k) action and inverse extraction recovers that orbit. For compact rotations (λ1,t1t2λ2,t1μ1,t2μ2), the chain factors are (t1t2)^-1,diag(t2^-1,t1^-1,h),1, matching raw framing weights e_a^-1. The construction is natural for framed first-order families in the exact locally-free/base-change range; it includes k=0 and reducible/flat summands. This is an intrinsic normal form, not an equivalence with an incorrectly dimensioned historical displayed block.

obligations: Lift the positive holomorphic σ-reality isomorphism and its involutive identities to the monad, proving existence/uniqueness up to the precise chain homotopies.
Show positivity of the induced internal normalizations from real-line positivity, without simply assuming the middle Hermitian form positive.
Normalize the leading μ matrices and real structure by explicit linear/unitary transformations; prove all required transversality and constant-rank statements.
Extract exact raw moment coefficients, prove regularity and the equivalence of full-rank and stable/costable conditions in these conventions.
Prove residual changes are exactly U(k), inverse extraction uniqueness, framing, compact rotations and first-order-family compatibility.

Keep global charge normalization explicit: finite O(m) resolution and line-class comparison identify algebraic and topological Chern characters; the positive incidence point/fiber Thom calculation gives π*u=H².
